goal_and_scope: Record the exact generator interface explicitly reused by the producer; no independent reconstruction, theorem dependency, reverse implication or algorithmic complexity transfer.

Destination common positive clocks, exact coordinate generator identity and conditional entropy proof.
Producer identifies the interface reuse and excludes CRN complexity transfer.

inherited_inputs: Exact source proof and destination note; both source_derived_unreviewed at repository intake.
acquired_inputs: Byte hashes and inclusive source ranges inspected; no coefficient oracle, scientific execution or independent proof audit acquired.
representation_and_assumptions: See paired_contracts. Both use exact finite-state continuous-time generators and elapsed time; domain, supplied rates, projection, stationary requirements and costs differ.
exact_missing_lemma: Independently reconstruct the destination lift under CB; prove a sufficient cover-specific balance condition or a genuine cover counterexample. Source CRN simulation bounds do not establish CB.
comparator: Exact Markov generator intertwining is established mathematics; correct embedded jump choices alone do not imply elapsed-time stationary marginals.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Reconstruct Q(f o pr_i)=r_i Lf exactly for every state and scalar test function with the same positive r_i. State-dependent coordinate activity is an interface failure. Cover-specific falsification additionally requires offsets, coverage and private witnesses.
unresolved_or_UNKNOWN: Independent correctness and historical priority of both source accounts
Efficient acquisition of legal directions or lift coefficients
Any reverse theorem or computational bound
status_note: Producer-reported interface reuse recorded as CANDIDATE CONNECTION pending independent reconstruction; no claim-status promotion.
forbidden_transfers: Reaction batching or passive slowdown bounds

source.object_domain: Finite mass-action CTMC with catalyst/waste extension and count augmentation; nonexplosion required for composed path laws.
source.supplied: Correctly normalized transformed rates, fixed network/volume, projection pi and stated population/batching/slowdown/random-variate promises.
source.acquired: Rate endpoint envelope and implementation resources must be charged under the N735 contract; not acquired here.
source.interface: Q_prime(f o pi)=Q f o pi on the projected configuration and augmented labelled counters.
source.guarantee: Equality of elapsed-time projected CTMC/count laws under the exact interface, with content/clock conditioning restrictions.
source.error_and_success: Ideal exact distribution under its supplied primitives; finite-bit output remains OPEN.
source.cost: N735 expected rate-query/batching bounds depend on its separate CRN structure. They are not generic costs of generator projection.

destination.object_domain: Finite additive space F_p^N, fixed subspace W and coset-preserving CTMC; odd prime p.
destination.supplied: For every nonzero scaling x, legal support-cone coefficients with one fixed positive clock vector r (CB).
destination.acquired: No efficient coefficient/direction acquisition proved; all scalings/directions may require exponential enumeration.
destination.interface: Q_joint(f o pr_i)=r_i L f o pr_i, with r_i independent of state.
destination.guarantee: Each coset admits stationary law with scalar marginals pi; entropy subadditivity yields p^{codim W}<=K0^N conditionally on CB.
destination.error_and_success: Exact finite existence theorem under CB; no mixing, efficient sampling or unconditional cover guarantee.
destination.cost: No rate-query, bit-time or physical complexity bound imported; even finding the lift is an unresolved algorithmic task.

reciprocity.forward: Only the exact elapsed-time generator-projection mechanism is reused, with an independently specified destination generator and CB. Review of a proof pattern is not establishment of either full source claim.
reciprocity.reverse: No implication back to the CRN compiler, passive-event slowdown or finite-bit implementation. A finite-field entropy theorem does not supply CRN rates or random variates.
